bugs_found: transfer() does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal: float inputs can raise TypeError or mix binary-float semantics into money path
transfer() mutates source before destination update; if account_to.balance + amount raises or setter fails, balances become inconsistent without rollback
transfer() only rejects object-identity self-transfer, allowing two Account objects with same id to transfer to themselves logically
compound_interest() and loan_payment() silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing fractional inputs without error
loan_payment() treats None/falsey monthly_rate as zero, silently masking missing or invalid rate input
functions do not reject NaN/Infinity Decimals, allowing invalid monetary/rate values or unexpected Decimal exceptions
apply_fee() can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, silently creating nonsensical negative proceeds
fx_convert() does not validate positive/finite FX rates, so zero/negative/NaN rates can produce invalid conversions
